_note: Platform capabilities manifest — what the RUNTIME provides to ANY project, project-agnostic. Agents (e.g. the Planner's feasibility judge and decomposer) read this so a task that USES a provided capability is FEASIBLE: the implementer CALLS the capability, it does NOT build the model/algorithm from scratch. This is platform state, never project state — adding a project changes nothing here. Editable without a rebuild (bind-mounted).

capabilities.name: Vision-language model
capabilities.provides: Describe, caption, classify, or analyze an image; extract text, attributes, or structured data from an image.
capabilities.via: The multimodal chat model (Gemma 4 E4B) accepts image input — the SAME model stack the agents already use. Call it with the image and a prompt; do not train or implement a vision/ML model from scratch.

capabilities.name: Text generation & reasoning model
capabilities.provides: Generate, summarize, classify, extract, translate, or transform text; produce structured JSON.
capabilities.via: The chat model (Gemma 4 E4B) via agent_server — call it with a prompt.

capabilities.name: Text embeddings & reranker
capabilities.provides: Semantic similarity, ranking, and near-duplicate detection over text.

capabilities.name: Google OAuth2 authentication
capabilities.provides: Authenticate an end user with their Google account and obtain a verified email/identity.
capabilities.via: oauth2-proxy at the edge performs the handshake; the verified identity is forwarded as a request header. Do not implement the OAuth2 handshake or token exchange from scratch — consume the forwarded identity.
